name: Feature request
about: A new widget, capability, or improvement idea
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What do you want to be able to do?**
Describe the problem or idea, not just the feature name.

**How would it look/work?**
A quick sketch (even hand-drawn), a description of the interaction, or a
similar feature in another app all help.

**Would you be up for building it yourself?**
If yes — check [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) and open an issue
first to align on approach before diving in.
